title: Kinetic Sobolev Spaces
summary: We define and study homogeneous kinetic Sobolev spaces adapted to the Kolmogorov equation. We consider both local and non-local diffusion. The spaces are built from the Lebesgue spaces L p for all integrability exponents p $\in$ (1, $\infty$) with regularity assumptions in the transport and diffusive directions according to the scaling of the Kolmogorov equation. The regularity scale accommodates weak and strong solutions. We prove that the proposed spaces satisfy sharp embeddings quantifying the transfer-ofregularity {à} la Bouchut-H{ö}rmander, continuity-in-time in the spirit of Lions and…
